search.name: RP-TBX
search.website_text:
# RP-TBX Kitsune Edition Original Plugin "The Roleplayer's Toolbox" by annaclemens Fixed by Astralis - Fixed to work with .NET7. Installation Instructions: Go to your dalamud settings, and under the 'experimental tab' add the following link:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ML-Astra/dalamud-plugins/main/repo.json You should then be able to install it from your list.

variant.author: EdeGoldstein
variant.description:
A collection of useful tools for roleplayers.

- Choose a PF or use the /route command to set a destination and get
  told the fastest way to navigate to any house.
- Enable click-to-examine on left or right click.
- Prevent untargeting or changing your target.
- Set any emote on your hotbar, such as sleep or object sit.
- Add the /emoteid command to use any emote by its ID.
- Disable the /doze emote snap so you can use the sleep emote
  anywhere.
 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neonmaus/RoleplayersToolbox/main/repo.json)
